getReputationScore(uint256).details: Uses a prior of (alpha=2 successes, beta=1 failure), so a fresh         provider starts at ~66 and the score only stabilizes after         many calls. This avoids giving spammers a perfect score for a         single successful call.         score = (completed + alpha) / (completed + slashed + alpha + beta) * 100         Examples (alpha=2, beta=1):           0 completed, 0 slashed  -> 66           1 completed, 0 slashed  -> 75          10 completed, 0 slashed  -> 92           5 completed, 1 slashed  -> 78           0 completed, 1 slashed  -> 50

params.erc8004TokenId: Token ID in the Arc IdentityRegistry                        (0x8004A818BFB912233c491871b3d84c89A494BD9e).                        Caller must be the current owner of this token.

updatePayPerCall(address).details: Use when upgrading PayPerCall to a new version.

completedCalls(uint256).notice: Raw completed counter for off-chain UIs.

getProviderTokenId(uint256).notice: Returns the ERC-8004 tokenId bound to a provider.         Returns 0 for v1 providers (no NFT bound).

getReputationScore(uint256).notice: Bayesian reputation score on a 0-100 scale.

incCompleted(uint256).notice: Called by PayPerCall after a successful receipt submission.

incSlashed(uint256).notice: Called by PayPerCall when a call is slashed.

isNFTBound(uint256).notice: Returns true if a provider registered via v2 (has NFT bound).

markCallStarted(uint256).notice: Called by PayPerCall when a call opens. Blocks unstake until         the matching `markCallFinished` fires.

register(address,uint256,uint256,uint32,.notice: v1 registration — no NFT required. Existing providers unaffected.

registerV2(uint256,address,uint256,uint2.notice: v2 registration — requires caller to own an ERC-8004 identity NFT.         Binds the NFT tokenId to the new providerId for cross-protocol         identity portability across the Arc ecosystem.         v1 `register()` remains untouched — existing providers are         unaffected and do NOT need to migrate.

setPayPerCall(address).notice: One-time wire-up of the PayPerCall contract address. Admin         sets this right after deploying PayPerCall. Cannot be changed         after first set — prevents rug-pull where admin swaps the         slasher to a malicious contract.

slashedCalls(uint256).notice: Raw slashed counter for off-chain UIs.

updatePayPerCall(address).notice: Update the authorized PayPerCall contract (admin only).
